summary: Callan JMB Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into an At-The-Market Issuance Sales Agreement with Alexander Capital, L.P. This is a routine shelf takedown for an at-the-market offering of up to $5M of common stock, not a special situation. The company can sell shares on Nasdaq subject to mutual agreement, pays a 3% commission, and intends net proceeds for working capital. There are no deal terms like price, premium, or close date; this is a capital-raising mechanism, not a transformative event.
